workflows..github/workflows/pr-validation.yml:
name: SPLRAD Steward / PR Validation

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, labeled, unlabeled]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: steward-pr-validation-${{ github.repository_id }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      policy: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.sha }}
      profile: ${{ steps.profile.outputs.name }}
    steps:
      - name: 解析中央规则提交
        id: policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          value="${GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA}"
          [[ "$value" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]] || { echo "工作流来源不是完整提交编号" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "sha=${value,,}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: 检出合并候选
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { path: target, fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: 检出中央规则
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          repository: splrad/steward
          ref: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.sha }}
          path: steward-policy
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with: { node-version-file: steward-policy/.node-version, cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: steward-policy/package-lock.json }
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
        working-directory: steward-policy
      - name: 选择验证配置
        id: profile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          case "${{ github.repository_id }}" in
            1187527897) echo "name=layerscape" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
            1296724484) echo "name=steward" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;;
            *)
              if [[ "${{ github.event.repository.private }}" == "true" ]]; then
                echo "私有仓库尚未纳管" >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "name=public-basic" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              ;;
          esac
      - name: validation-policy:${{ steps.policy.outputs.sha }}
        env:
          VALIDATION_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          VALIDATION_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
        run: node steward-policy/packages/runner/dist/index.js validate --workspace target --repository-id "${{ github.repository_id }}" --profile "${{ steps.profile.outputs.name }}"
workflows..github/workflows/sync-managed-labels.ym:
name: SPLRAD Steward / Sync Managed Labels

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      repositoryId: { required: false, type: string }
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["SPLRAD Steward / Deploy Runtime"]
    types: [completed]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * *"

permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: steward-managed-labels-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  synchronize:
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      github.event_name == 'schedule' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment:
      name: steward-automation
      deployment: false
    steps:
      - name: 解析已部署规则提交
        id: policy
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          DEPLOYED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUNTIME_URL: https://splrad-steward-runtime.alearner-5ef.workers.dev
        run: |
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            policy_sha="$DEPLOYED_HEAD_SHA"
          else
            policy_sha="$(node --input-type=module -e 'const response=await fetch(process.env.RUNTIME_URL+"/health"); if(!response.ok) process.exit(1); const body=await response.json(); if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/u.test(body.policySha)) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(body.policySha)')"
          fi
          printf 'policy_sha=%s\n' "$policy_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { ref: "${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: 同步受管标签定义
        env:
          APP_ID: "4243096"
          INSTALLATION_ID: "145952003"
          STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ inputs.repositoryId }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
          SYNC_TRIGGER: ${{ github.event_name }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_ID: ${{ github.actor_id }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_LOGIN: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          repository_arguments=()
          if [[ -n "$REPOSITORY_ID" ]]; then
            repository_arguments+=(--repository-id "$REPOSITORY_ID")
          fi
          node packages/runner/dist/index.js sync-managed-labels "${repository_arguments[@]}" --policy-sha "$POLICY_SHA"
workflows..github/workflows/sync-review-instructio:
name: SPLRAD Steward / Sync Review Instructions

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      repositoryId: { required: false, type: string }
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["SPLRAD Steward / Deploy Runtime"]
    types: [completed]

permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: steward-review-instructions-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  resolve:
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      policy_sha: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.targets.outputs.matrix }}
    environment:
      name: steward-automation
      deployment: false
    steps:
      - name: 解析已部署规则提交
        id: policy
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          DEPLOYED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUNTIME_URL: https://splrad-steward-runtime.alearner-5ef.workers.dev
        run: |
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            policy_sha="$DEPLOYED_HEAD_SHA"
          else
            policy_sha="$(node --input-type=module -e 'const response=await fetch(process.env.RUNTIME_URL+"/health"); if(!response.ok) process.exit(1); const body=await response.json(); if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/u.test(body.policySha)) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(body.policySha)')"
          fi
          printf 'policy_sha=%s\n' "$policy_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { ref: "${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: 解析同步仓库与模式
        id: targets
        shell: bash
        env:
          APP_ID: "4243096"
          INSTALLATION_ID: "145952003"
          STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ inputs.repositoryId }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
          SYNC_TRIGGER: ${{ github.actor_id == '301115370' && 'app-redrive' || github.event_name }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_ID: ${{ github.actor_id }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_LOGIN: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          repository_arguments=()
          if [[ -n "$REPOSITORY_ID" ]]; then
            repository_arguments+=(--repository-id "$REPOSITORY_ID")
          fi
          node packages/runner/dist/index.js review-sync-targets "${repository_arguments[@]}" --policy-sha "$POLICY_SHA"

  synchronize:
    needs: resolve
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 1
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.resolve.outputs.matrix) }}
    concurrency:
      group: steward-pr-body-${{ matrix.repositoryId }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment:
      name: steward-automation
      deployment: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.resolve.outputs.policy_sha }}", persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: 同步代码审查说明
        shell: bash
        env:
          APP_ID: "4243096"
          INSTALLATION_ID: "145952003"
          STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.STEWARD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          RUNTIME_URL: https://splrad-steward-runtime.alearner-5ef.workers.dev
          REPOSITORY_ID: ${{ matrix.repositoryId }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.policy_sha }}
          SYNC_TRIGGER: ${{ github.actor_id == '301115370' && 'app-redrive' || github.event_name }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_ID: ${{ github.actor_id }}
          TRIGGER_ACTOR_LOGIN: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          repository_arguments=()
          if [[ -n "$REPOSITORY_ID" ]]; then
            repository_arguments+=(--repository-id "$REPOSITORY_ID")
          fi
          node packages/runner/dist/index.js sync-review-instructions "${repository_arguments[@]}" --policy-sha "$POLICY_SHA"
